records.preparation: Dilute the concentrate with water immediately before use. ILFORD documents 1+9, 1+19 and 1+29.
records.reuseInstructions: The diluted developer can be used one-shot or reused during one working session. Reuse is supported at 1+9 and 1+19; 1+29 is not recommended for reuse.
records.capacityText: Per 500 ml bottle: at 1+9, 16 films one-shot or 50 reused; at 1+19, 32 one-shot or 50 reused; at 1+29, 50 one-shot and reuse is not recommended.
records.shelfLifeOpened: Concentrate stored at 4-20 C: 24 months in full tightly capped bottles; 4 months in half-full tightly capped bottles.
records.storageNotes: Store in original containers in cool, dry conditions at 4-20 C.

records.preparation: Dilute concentrate 1+4 with water to make working-strength replenisher. For machine-tank developer add ILFOTEC DD STARTER at 1+250, equivalent to 4 ml starter per litre.
records.reuseInstructions: Designed primarily for replenished systems. In unreplenished deep tanks, one litre can be reused for up to 10 rolls with approximately 10% development-time increase for each successive film after the first; ILFORD recommends replenishment as the more consistent method.
records.capacityText: Unreplenished working-strength developer: up to 10 rolls of 135-36 or 120 per litre. A 5 litre concentrate bottle makes 25 litres working strength and provides replenishment for about 500 rolls of 135-36.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Full unopened concentrate stored at 5-20 C: 2 years.
records.shelfLifeOpened: Once opened, use concentrate completely within 3 months and keep tightly sealed until use.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Replenished process-tank developer: general replacement guide 6-12 months. Unreplenished working solution: 6 months full capped; 2 months under floating lid; 1 month half-full tightly capped.
records.storageNotes: Use floating lids/covers on developer and replenisher tanks when idle; store concentrate cool at 5-20 C.
records.sourceTitle: ILFORD ILFOTEC DD Film Developer and Replenisher Technical Information

records.productName: KODAK PROFESSIONAL T-MAX RS Developer and Replenisher
records.preparation: Prepare working-strength solution according to package size; Kodak states T-MAX RS Developer and Replenisher is supplied to make working-strength solution that is also used as replenisher.
records.reuseInstructions: Use the mixed solution as the working-tank solution or replenisher. Kodak recommends T-MAX RS for replenished systems. Add 45 ml replenisher for each 135-36 or 120 roll or 8x10-inch sheet processed.
records.capacityText: Kodak matrix gives a useful tank capacity of 16 8x10-inch sheets per US gallon, about 4 per litre, and notes that capacity can be increased by replenishment.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Concentrate in a full closed container: indefinite according to Kodak's black-and-white chemistry matrix.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Working-tank solution: up to 6 months in a full closed container; the Kodak matrix also lists 24 hours in a tray and 1 month in a tank under its working-solution keeping properties.
records.sourceTitle: KODAK PROFESSIONAL T-MAX Developers J-86 and B&W Chemicals Matrix E103CF
